name: @sos-2/reasoning-broker
description: SOS 2.0 Reasoning Broker (Work Order P6): the NON-AUTHORITATIVE reasoning plane of the Spirit Orchestrator. The ReasoningProviderPort is an INJECTABLE PORT — providers are replaceable reasoning mechanisms, never authorities; no real LLM API call exists anywhere in this package (the P8 reference-body precedent: honest capability advertisement, typed records, explicit simulated markers; real providers attach later through the same ports without contract change). THE DEFAULT MANAGED PROVIDER IS ALWAYS PRESENT with zero user configuration — a user NEVER needs to connect a personal LLM to start (pinned by tests). OPTIONAL bring-your-own provider adapters share the same port shape and report honest NOT_YET_CONNECTED statuses until connected — no fabricated availability. Provider routing is capability/cost/context driven and every selection is a TYPED, RECORDED RoutingDecision. Model/version provenance rides EVERY broker output (provider identity + model + version + the routing decision that selected it). ALL broker output is typed NonAuthoritativeAnalysis carrying a structural non_authoritative:true marker: it can inform decomposition, planning and summaries but can NEVER enter authority, semantic-identity or verification-verdict paths (pinned by structural scans — no authority or verification field is ever populated from broker output). Deterministic reference providers are SIMULATED with explicit markers; zero real network in src. Determinism: no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env in this package's src — the clock is injected and analysis ids are content-derived.
